        local part = Instance.new('Part', workspace)
part.Size = Vector3.new(500, 20, 530.1)

part.Anchored = true

game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = part.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 15, 0)

local a = true
local rs = game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped
if a == true then

if v.ClassName == "Tool" and v.Name == "Weight" then
v.Parent = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character

end
game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.muscleEvent:FireServer("rep")
end
end
end)

scripts.title: Multi Stats Farm
scripts.script:
game:GetService("RunService").Stepped:connect(
    function()
        for _, tool in ipairs(game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Backpack:GetChildren()) do
            if tool.Name == "Punch" or tool.Name == "Ground Slam" or tool.Name == "Stomp" then
                tool:Destroy()
            elseif tool:IsA("Tool") then
                tool.Parent = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Character
            end
        end

        local tool = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
        tool:Activate()
    end)

game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.Health = 0
